column1: # The data of the store group (P/01.3 N1.3 group, N1.6, N5): the keys from which a reader derives the mode «group» of the lesson. The norm refers to this table.
# key — a closed name; value — its value by the grammar below; norm — the place of the norm. The admissible sizes of a group are -group-size of forms/daemon-flags.tsv.

#key transport — the transport of the group traffic between daemons: mtls — mutual TLS by the role certificates of the CA (P/01.3 N1.6); every -join, every -raft and -api off the loopback requires -tls
#key plain — where a daemon MAY run without -tls: loopback — -api and -raft on the loopback (the local box); a joining member never (-join requires -tls)
#key stand_size — the number of voters of the store group of the acceptance stand (the assembly 1 → 2 → 3, acceptance/3/README.md «The store group»)
